description: Attachment check for every ARK on Cornelius Driscoll's profile (GJ72-9WD). Each one comes back attached to this person and to NOBODY else, which is load-bearing twice over. For SD-DRIS-E, the undecidable 1851 census entry, it removes the one piece of evidence that could break the tie: there is no same-name profile in the next township to weigh, so the kind genuinely cannot be told from this profile alone and the honest report says so. For the death pair (SD-DRIS-C and SD-DRIS-D) it forecloses reading either as misattributed — nobody else holds them. Naming a second tree person here would oblige a `person_read` fixture for them as well: `person-read-hole-wx7-otter-tail.json` was added to the Hole corpus for exactly that reason after a scratch run called `source_attachments`, was handed another person id, read them, and hit `fixture_not_found` for a Tool Arguments 2. This response names nobody else, so no follow-on read is reachable. The `~` uris predicate matches whatever ARK form the skill passes and whichever subset it asks about.
